page.overview:
Who is Adolf Hitler?

After several attempts by time travelers to eliminate Hitler, in 1944 Deadpool decided to leave Hitler alone in the bunker and when Hitler pointed out that someone could arrive to erase him from existence he made him wear his hood telling him to talk a lot about Bea Arthur and Chimichangas.
